name: Education is the foundation of national development.
trans: 教育是国家发展的基础。

name: Everyone should have equal access to education.
trans: 每个人都应享有平等的受教育机会。

name: Compulsory education enables children to receive basic education.
trans: 义务教育使儿童能够接受基础教育。

name: Higher education provides students with more opportunities for future development.
trans: 高等教育为学生未来的发展提供更多机会。

name: Online learning is convenient, but it requires strong self-discipline.
trans: 在线学习很方便，但需要较强的自律。

name: Extracurricular activities are beneficial to students’ all-round development.
trans: 课外活动有利于学生的全面发展。

name: Teachers should encourage students to think critically rather than memorize facts.
trans: 教师应鼓励学生批判性思考，而不是死记硬背。

name: A good learning environment can improve students’ academic performance.
trans: 良好的学习环境能提高学生的学业表现。

name: Vocational education can help students develop practical skills.
trans: 职业教育能帮助学生培养实践技能。

name: Students should learn to balance study and extracurricular activities.
trans: 学生应学会平衡学习和课外活动。
